Experienced, responsible house-sitter/pet-sitter
available for summer work
I am a Millbridge College junior looking for summer work.
If you plan to be away during the summer months, you
may want someone to feed your pets, water your garden,
bring in your mail, and generally keep your home clean
and safe in your absence. I get along well with cats and
dogs and can do all kinds of housework. I also have
experience in landscape work and can perform tasks like
mowing, pruning, and tree-trimming for an additional
charge. I will be happy to provide references. I prefer
longer-term jobs (several weeks would be ideal) but will
accept shorter-term work.
For house-sitting and pet-sitting, I charge $75 per day.
I am fluent in English and Spanish.
You can contact me at 512-555-0124.
Alex Carpenter
